records.title: Mechanical and Material Requirements for Externally Threaded Fasteners
records.scope: Covers mechanical and material requirements for inch-series carbon and alloy steel bolts, screws, studs, and U-bolts used in automotive and related industries, in sizes up to 1-1/2 inch inclusive, across Grades 1, 2, 5, 5.1, 5.2, 7, 8, 8.1, and 8.2.
records.public_summary: Referenced for SAE inch-fastener grade mechanical requirements (proof load stress, minimum tensile strength) used by BoltLab's fastener_property_classes dataset. This phase directly read two independent manufacturer engineering data sheets (Southwest Bolt 2020; Boltport Fasteners LLP) that cite this standard and cross-verified Grades 1, 2, 5, and 8; the standard's own text was not directly read (proprietary/SAE-published). Compared against ASME B18.3.1 during this phase's sourcing work: ASME B18.3.1 is a dimensional/geometric standard for socket-head cap screws, shoulder screws, set screws, and hex keys, not a mechanical-property standard for general bolts/screws/studs, and is therefore judged NOT required for BoltLab's v1 fastener-strength scope -- see docs/fastener-load-strength Phase 2 report for the full SAE-vs-ASME scope decision and evidence.
records.copyright_note: No copyrighted standards text is reproduced; only public summary and reference metadata, interpreted from freely-published manufacturer engineering data sheets that themselves cite this standard.
